ideas.title: The Impact of Obsolete Systems on Minnesota's Fraud Prevention
ideas.description: This story would investigate the role of outdated systems in Minnesota's fraud prevention efforts
ideas.angle: Exploring the connection between obsolete systems and fraud vulnerability
questions: How do obsolete systems contribute to fraud vulnerability?
What steps can be taken to update these systems?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe that understanding the impact of obsolete systems on fraud prevention is crucial to developing effective solutions.
